scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, capture receipts, and every receipt-listed PNG tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully.
review_method.rendering: Every receipt-listed lane-02 PNG was opened individually with tools.view_image(detail="original"); no collage or downscaling. For the single TikZ finding, the complete tile was checked standalone and the diagram region was locally cropped for overlap/clipping verification.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: For each assignment entry, compared assignment title and expected source/HTML hashes with the frozen source, snapshot, and assigned HTML; the rendered tile sequence was reviewed for complete body coverage.
review_method.boundary: Read-only local audit. No source/item/app/publication edits, network calls, tests, builds, gates, commits, or pushes. Only lane-02.md and lane-02.json are written.

frontmatter_parse_blocker_review.classification: Parser metadata blockers are recorded independently from visual findings. No lane-02 item is affected; all lane-02 entries retain canonical snapshot coverage.

findings.source_content: The example defines u_1=(1/2)(x-1,y) on K_1 and u_2=-(1/2)(x,y-1) on K_2, with integrated outward fluxes +1/2 and -1/2 on their shared diagonal. The TikZ block draws arrows labeled u_1 and u_2 at lines 83–84, while line 88 identifies them as schematic flux arrows.
findings.symptom: Both arrows are drawn wholly inside their cells and do not show the stated interface flux directions. The K_1 arrow points down-left and the K_2 arrow up-right; evaluating the displayed fields at their arrow tails gives vectors pointing up-left in both cells. If the marks are flux arrows, neither direction agrees with the stated outward flux convention on the shared diagonal. The small crop also shows the lambda label placed over the diagonal, reducing label clarity.
findings.verification: Opened both tiles separately at original resolution. The diagram is in tile --02; inspected that full tile standalone and a local crop around the triangle and labels to check clipping and overlap. The square, diagonal, K_1/K_2 regions, f=+1/-1 labels, and shared-facet lambda are present. There is no tile-boundary clipping.
findings.suggested_repair: Either remove the arrows or redraw them explicitly as outward facet-flux arrows on the common diagonal, with opposite cell-outward orientations and +1/2 and -1/2 sign labels. Move lambda clear of the diagonal. Keep the caption that the diagram is schematic and the proof supplies exact integrals.

existing_diagram_checks.review: The square is split by its lower-left to upper-right diagonal, matching K_1={0<y<x<1} and K_2={0<x<y<1}; labels and f signs occupy the expected regions. The shared-facet multiplier is present. The u_i arrows do not match the stated field directions or the shared-facet outward-flux convention; see rendering finding render-01. The lambda label overlaps the diagonal in the local crop. The remaining proof is algebraic and explicitly gives exact integrated fluxes, so it does not rely on the drawing.

candidate_diagrams.claim: The periodic MAC grid stores pressure at cell centers and velocity component i at the right face of cell j; G_h takes forward cell-to-face differences and D_h takes right-minus-left face differences.
candidate_diagrams.kind: 2D periodic staggered-grid placement and operator stencil
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The exact component locations and compatible gradient/divergence index shifts are central to this definition, and the companion checkerboard-pressure example depends on the face/cell offset. One compact grid sketch can communicate both the storage offset and the sign orientation more directly than prose alone.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Show a pair of neighboring cells with q_j and q_{j+e_i} at centers, v_{i,j} on their common face, the +e_i orientation, and the gradient difference (q_{j+e_i}-q_j)/h. Extend with adjacent face values v_{i,j-e_i}, v_{i,j} around a cell and mark D_h=(v_{i,j}-v_{i,j-e_i})/h. Indicate periodic wrap at the domain edge; do not imply nonperiodic boundaries.
candidate_diagrams.status: Optional; the storage rules and formulas are complete in the definition.

limitations: This is a rendering and diagram-opportunity audit, not a general mathematical audit of all claims. All assigned lane-02 inputs have canonical snapshot coverage; there are no scoped frontmatter parse blockers.
